description: The per-node `settings:` block of a pipeline node (5b-1): its keys, bounds, the node types that admit each setting, and the readable refusal texts. The single source for the Worker compiler (services/elitea-worker-rust src/agents/graph/node_settings_parity_tests.rs and libs/rust/agent-runtime src/graph/node_settings.rs), Main's save-time check (services/elitea-main internal/domain/pipelinelimits/node_settings_test.go) and the Web editor (apps/elitea-web runtimeContract.nodeSettings.test.ts). A node type gains settings here and in every layer in the same change; there are no feature flags. A node type that is not listed under `families` refuses the whole block with `family_not_yet` or, for a pause, `family_pause`. Every refusal reads `Node <id>: <text>`; document-level refusals read `<text>`.

refusals.malformed: Its settings are malformed: use a mapping of the known settings with plain values.
refusals.family_not_yet: Settings are not available for this node type yet.
refusals.family_pause: Settings are not available for a node that pauses the run.
refusals.fanout_owned: Settings are not available for a node inside a Parallel or Map yet.
refusals.with_recovery: Settings cannot be combined with recovery or failure_handler on one node.
refusals.retry_not_allowed: Retry on fail is not available for this node type.
refusals.timeout_not_allowed: Timeout is not available for this node type.
refusals.max_tries_range: Max tries must be between 2 and 5.
refusals.wait_range: Wait between tries must be between 100 and 300000 ms.
refusals.timeout_range: Timeout must be between 1000 and 900000 ms.
refusals.retry_fields_need_retry: Max tries and wait between tries need Retry on fail.
refusals.error_transition_required: On error 'error output' needs an error transition.
refusals.error_transition_unexpected: An error transition needs On error 'error output'.
refusals.error_transition_target: The error transition must name END or another node of this pipeline outside any Parallel or Map.
refusals.always_output_reducer: Always output data cannot write an output that uses the sum_int or merge reducer.
refusals.router_continue_needs_default: On error 'continue' on a Router needs an explicit default output.
refusals.node_errors_type: The state key node_errors must be a list with no reducer or the append reducer when a node continues on error.
refusals.node_errors_nested_mapping: An Agent node cannot map node_errors into or out of a nested pipeline.
